// Suggested section: == Appium automation

- On iOS, automated tests now find, read, and tap elements on system alerts and popups, such as the alert that asks you to turn on Location Services. Previously, reading an element property such as `enabled`, or clicking a button on the alert, returned a `No active application elements` error, and the alert stayed open. The fix applies to iPhone and iPad. Behavior for elements in apps, including iPad multi-window apps, is unchanged.
